analogy.rationale: HCV inhibitors target viral enzymes (NS3/4A protease, NS5B polymerase, NS5A) that are not expressed in these human cell lines, so they should produce little to no transcriptional response; other antiviral classes also lack host targets in these cells and serve as the closest low-similarity analogs.
